methods.html:
Methods & Config

10,000 unique prompts sampled without content filtering from the pinned curated Reddit dataset; eight further prompts for warm-up. Sampling seed 42. Prefix caching disabled. 100 batches of 100; maximum 128 concurrent sequences. BF16, one GPU. No retries or rejection sampling. Model initialization and warm-up timed separately. A timed generation batch includes input prefill and output decode; output/report writing is outside its timing.
